SitePartDef.label: replicator-consumed ruins
SitePartDef.description: The stripped remains of a once-technological site after a Replicator swarm passed through it. Structural ribs terminate abruptly, machines have been hollowed out and standardized blocks of dormant Replicator Matter remain where the swarm left excess mass behind.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: You have reached the consumed ruins. Nothing is attacking immediately. What remains is worse in a different way: architecture has been eaten into regular block-sized gaps, machinery is little more than shell and several clusters of dormant Replicator Matter lie among the debris. Uncontained Matter follows its normal half-day dormancy before reassembly risk begins, so extraction or containment should be planned before lingering.
